They're claiming mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with someone in Pakistan isn't enough to hold him, and he was only allegedly making telephonic contact with that Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri.” But this reeks of elite coordination from the shadows, where institutions twist the system to downplay real threats and shield whatever hidden channels are actually operating. They're flipping the script to paint it as overreach when it's really about protecting those coordinated interests from any real scrutiny.
